headline: AI Agents Set to Outnumber Humans in Economy, According to Coinbase CEO
summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong predicts that AI agents will outnumber humans in the economy, signaling a significant shift in the labor market and prompting discussions on the future of work and regulation.
whyItMatters: This prediction underscores the rapid advancement of AI and its profound impact on the job market, necessitating urgent policy and societal considerations.
